actions.name: jq_transform
actions.title: JSON transformation
actions.help: This action allows users to choose JSON data source and perform transformation using jq query language.

input.name: sources
input.label: Data Sources

properties.name: name
properties.label: Data source name
properties.hint: Provide an alias name for the data source. E.g: contacts, orders. This name might be used to identify the source.

properties.name: handling
properties.label: Input format
properties.hint: Choose how this data is passed to jq: Input for standard JSON input (`.`), Raw file for plain text, or Slurp file to load multiple JSON values as an array.

properties.name: data_source_type
properties.label: Data source type
properties.hint: Provide the data source type. To pass file content or object directly from upstream action/trigger chooser Content Stream. You can also refer to a file in Workato FileStorage.

properties.name: source_stream
properties.label: Content input stream
properties.hint: Pass the contents or file contents reference pill here from an upstream action or trigger.

properties.name: wf_file_path
properties.label: FileStorage file
properties.hint: Provide the FileStorage file full path here to fetch the data. For example, “samplepath/filename.json”.

input.hint: Specify data-sources to perform transformation over them

input.name: jq_expression
input.label: jq expression
input.hint: Provide a jq expression to convert your JSON data into JSON format. For example, .items[] | [ keys[] as $k | .[$k] ] | @csv .

input.name: slurp
input.label: Process inputs together
input.hint: Enable this to pass all inputs to jq as a single array ( slurp mode, like `jq -s`) instead of processing them individually. Applies to all sources marked Input .

properties.name: type
properties.label: Output type
properties.hint: Select the type of the output. Use “Content stream” to share the contents as a streamable data pill to downstream actions. Use FileStorage file option to save output as a file in FileStorage system. U…

properties.name: wf_file_path
properties.label: FileStorage output folder
properties.hint: Choose or enter the path where the output file needs to be stored in Workato FileStorage. For example, “samplepath/path1/”

properties.name: wf_file_name
properties.label: FileStorage output file name
properties.hint: Define the name of the output file that needs to be stored in Workato FileStorage.

properties.name: mode
properties.label: File action
properties.hint: Choose how the destination file in FileStorage should be handled when the transformation runs. Create fails if the file already exists. Append and Overwrite create the file if it does not exist, or ap…

properties.name: sample_document
properties.label: Sample document
properties.hint: Provide a sample JSON document to generate the output schema for mapping fields.

properties.name: raw_output
properties.label: Raw output
properties.hint: Select Yes if the output should be in raw string format without escapes and quotes
